spans.s: अाट् (1) augment अा prefixed to roots beginning with a vowel in the imperfect, aorist and conditional, which is always accented (उदात्त); cf.
; (2) augment अा prefixed to the imperative first person terminations, e.g. करवाणि, करवै etc.; cf.
: (3) aug- ment अा to be prefixed to case- affixes which are डित् after nouns called nadī: e.g. कुमार्यं; cf
अाटच् tad.affix (आट) in the sense of possession added to the word वाच्; e.g. वाचाटः cf.
